clue.text: Weather may be, but greetings aren't at this time

definitions.text: Weather may be, but greetings aren't at this time

parts.words: Weather may be, but greetings aren't at this time
parts.note: at Christmas the weather can be icy cold, while the season's greetings are meant to be warm and friendly

explanation.surface: A seasonal contrast between cold winter weather and warm Christmas wishes.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective describes icy weather and, figuratively, an unfriendly, chilly manner of greeting.

clue.text: It offers various penalties in party games

indicators.note: various suggests the letters of the two words take assorted different positions

explanation.surface: A Christmas party game that hands out a range of penalties to the losers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'various' rearranges the eight letters of IT OFFERS.
explanation.definitionFit: In the parlour game, players hand over personal items as penalties and must redeem them by performing silly tasks.

clue.text: S American fowl-turkey perhaps?

explanation.surface: A South American bird compared with the festive turkey.
explanation.walkthrough: The second reading is whimsical: a turkey roasting at Christmas is a bird in the oven.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a South American songbird that builds domed mud nests, and jokingly any bird destined for roasting, such as a Christmas turkey.

clue.text: Joins in at the end of the festivities

indicators.note: the letters sit inside the last stretch of the word festivities

explanation.surface: Someone joins the party only as the celebrations are finishing.
explanation.definitionFit: To join two things is to link or fasten them together, as a knot does a rope.

clue.text: Delightful prince in panto given marching order

indicators.note: putting the word marching in a new order rearranges its letters

explanation.surface: The handsome prince of pantomime is told to march off the stage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'prince in panto' adds a nod to Prince Charming, the hero of the Cinderella pantomime; 'order' rearranges MARCHING.
explanation.definitionFit: Something delightful is pleasing and attractive, full of charm.

clue.text: Naturally, they add colour to the decorations

definitions.text: Naturally, they add colour to the decorations

parts.words: Naturally, they add colour to the decorations
parts.note: red fruits grown on an evergreen shrub brighten festive greenery without any paint or tinsel

explanation.surface: Natural touches that brighten Christmas decorations.
explanation.definitionFit: The scarlet fruit of the evergreen shrub traditionally decorates homes at Christmas.

clue.text: Carried away-like a Christmas present will be, we hear

indicators.note: we hear tells us a word is being judged by how it is spoken

parts.words: like a Christmas present will be
parts.note: a present is covered in paper, that is, wrapped

explanation.surface: Someone thrilled by a beautifully packaged Christmas gift.
explanation.definitionFit: Being enraptured or engrossed is being transported by emotion.

clue.text: The opposite of a sun-bonnet in winter?

definitions.text: The opposite of a sun-bonnet in winter?

parts.words: The opposite of a sun-bonnet in winter?
parts.note: a bonnet keeps the summer sun off; picture instead a frozen covering on a polar region

explanation.surface: Musing on what kind of headgear suits winter rather than summer.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a permanent covering of frozen water over a polar region, a cold cap rather than a sunny one.

clue.text: Glad tidings from Matthew, Mark, Luke and John?

definitions.text: Glad tidings from Matthew, Mark, Luke and John?

parts.words: Glad tidings from Matthew, Mark, Luke and John?
parts.note: the four evangelists each wrote an account of the good news of Christ's life

explanation.surface: Christmas good news from four friends who happen to share the evangelists' names.
explanation.definitionFit: The word derives from Old English for good news, and names the four New Testament accounts.

clue.text: How one danced at the party when not quite sober?

definitions.text: How one danced at the party

explanation.surface: A tipsy guest dancing unsteadily at the Christmas party.
explanation.definitionFit: It means danced a Scottish reel, and also staggered or swayed as a drunk does.

clue.text: They make good presents — for those on ice?

definitions.text: They make good presents — for those on ice?

parts.words: They make good presents — for those on ice?
parts.note: soft indoor footwear is a classic gift, and people on an icy surface tend to lose their footing

explanation.surface: Wondering what gift suits skaters or people walking on frozen paths.
explanation.definitionFit: These are comfortable house shoes, and also people who lose their footing.

clue.text: Revises match arranged for December 24th

indicators.note: arranged means the letters of the two words are set out in a new order

explanation.surface: Someone reworks the details of a fixture that has been organised.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arranged' rearranges the twelve letters of REVISES MATCH.
explanation.definitionFit: The day before the 25th of December is the evening of the festive vigil.

clue.text: Drops down after washing up?

parts.note: the tide falls back after coming in, as waves wash up on the shore and recede

explanation.surface: Somebody collapses exhausted once the Christmas dishes are done.
explanation.definitionFit: When the tide goes out it recedes and the water level falls.

clue.text: Common vehicles having winter fodder on board

annotationWithheld.why: Common vehicles having winter fodder on board (5): HAY inside SS, but 'on board' must be both the container signal and the source of SS, one word doing two jobs
annotationWithheld.clue: Common vehicles having winter fodder on board

clue.text: Fruit for December 25th, for example?

explanation.surface: A seasonal fruit eaten on Christmas Day.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the sweet fruit of a palm, and any particular day of the calendar, such as Christmas Day.

clue.text: Bottled spirit used by Aladdin

parts.note: spirit suggests an alcoholic drink, but this is a magical being kept in a lamp in the pantomime story

explanation.surface: Aladdin uses a drink from a bottle.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a magical being, a djinn, that grants wishes in the Arabian Nights tale.

clue.text: Piles of presents, perhaps, out of shape

indicators.note: out of here means taken out of their arrangement, so the word shape is jumbled

explanation.surface: Stacks of gifts lie disordered and squashed.
explanation.definitionFit: These are stacks or mounds, such as gifts piled under the tree.

clue.text: Themes I renew for the Magi

indicators.note: for is a loose signal here: the three words stand in for, or are remade into, the phrase defined

explanation.surface: A writer refreshes old topics for a piece about the Magi.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue has no conventional anagram signal; 'renew' hints at remaking, and 'for' stands between the twelve letters of THEMES I RENEW and the Magi they become.
explanation.definitionFit: The Magi are the kings from the East who brought gifts to the infant Jesus.

clue.text: Break the ice and stand some way away

indicators.note: to break the words up is to scatter their letters for rearranging

explanation.surface: Ending awkwardness then keeping your distance at a party.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the space between two points, how far off something is.

clue.text: The unfairness of Cinderella's sisters

parts.note: unfairness here is the opposite of being fair, meaning lacking beauty, as with the plain siblings of the pantomime

explanation.surface: Cinderella's siblings treat her unjustly.
explanation.walkthrough: In the pantomime Cinderella's step-sisters are the comic 'Ugly Sisters'; 'fair' also means beautiful.
explanation.definitionFit: Being unfair in the old sense of not good-looking is a lack of beauty.

clue.text: Making a tidy packet before Christmas

definitions.text: Making a tidy packet before Christmas

parts.words: Making a tidy packet before Christmas
parts.note: making a tidy packet sounds like earning a lot of money, but means neatly covering a present in paper

explanation.surface: A shopkeeper earns plenty in the run-up to Christmas.
explanation.definitionFit: This is covering presents in decorative paper to make neat parcels.

clue.text: Rare alarm shown about the start of Christmas

indicators.note: about means one piece goes round the other

parts.note: an alarm is a fright or scare

indicators.note: the start of points to the opening letter of the word Christmas

explanation.surface: A false alarm causes panic just as Christmas begins.
explanation.definitionFit: Something rare is in short supply and hard to find.

clue.text: It naturally gets lighter as Winter approaches

definitions.text: It naturally gets lighter as Winter approaches

parts.words: It naturally gets lighter as Winter approaches
parts.note: a northern stoat's brown coat turns white in the cold season

explanation.surface: Something that brightens as winter draws in.
explanation.definitionFit: The stoat in its white winter coat, whose fur trims royal robes.

clue.text: Eccentric chap bearing seasonal greetings

explanation.surface: An odd fellow carries Christmas wishes.
explanation.definitionFit: Informally an amusing oddball, and also a folded printed greeting sent at Christmas.

clue.text: A bell-shaped attachment to the Christmas parcel

indicators.note: shaped means the letters are formed into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A bell ornament tied to a Christmas parcel.
explanation.definitionFit: A tag tied to a gift shows who it is for and who sent it.

clue.text: It may hold needles on the tree — but only as a present

definitions.text: It may hold needles on the tree — but only as a present

parts.words: It may hold needles on the tree — but only as a present
parts.note: needles suggests pine needles, but this small sewing case could only be on the tree as a hanging gift

explanation.surface: Pine needles on the Christmas tree and a gift hanging among them.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a small ornamental case for sewing needles and pins.

clue.text: Do nothing like Jack in pantomime

explanation.surface: A lazy pantomime character called Jack.
explanation.walkthrough: In the pantomime Dick Whittington, Idle Jack is the comic lazy servant.
explanation.definitionFit: It means to laze about, and is the epithet of the lazy servant Jack in the pantomime.

clue.text: Form of decoration that has grown over the years

definitions.text: Form of decoration that has grown over the years

parts.words: Form of decoration that has grown over the years
parts.note: a decoration that has become bigger over time, literally a plant that has grown

explanation.surface: A Christmas custom that has become more elaborate with time.
explanation.definitionFit: The decorated fir or pine is a central Christmas ornament and a plant that grows slowly.

clue.text: Christmas present drawer

parts.note: a drawer sounds like a storage compartment for gifts, but this one pulls the sleigh

explanation.surface: A drawer in which Christmas gifts are hidden away.
explanation.definitionFit: These Arctic deer pull Santa's sleigh full of gifts.

clue.text: Stocking filler in a Royal House

explanation.surface: A small gift tucked into a stocking at a royal home.
explanation.definitionFit: A citrus fruit traditionally put in Christmas stockings, and the Dutch royal dynasty of that name.

clue.text: First name in a Christmas Carol

definitions.text: First name in a Christmas Carol

parts.words: First name in a Christmas Carol
parts.note: a carol suggests a song, but this is the Dickens story and its miser's forename

explanation.surface: The first name sung in a Christmas carol.
explanation.definitionFit: Scrooge, the miser of Dickens's A Christmas Carol, has this given name.

clue.text: Festivities involve five in lively dances

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the other

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral for five

explanation.surface: Christmas parties include a few spirited dances.
explanation.definitionFit: Merrymaking and lively celebrations, especially at festive times.
